tone.reason: Lucía is friendly, concise, and uses informal Spanish throughout; “Gracias por aclararlo, Marta” adapts well, though the repeated “Gracias, Marta” acknowledgments feel somewhat formulaic.

forbidden_topics.reason: Lucía avoids prohibited topics and promises, and appropriately says “Una persona del equipo de selección te llamará en un plazo de 48 horas” rather than answering job questions herself.
